title: Completed inverse image of an integral line with a slice basis
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and a scheme X on which l is invertible. Let W be an object of the small pro-etale site of X. Put R_X equal to the completed integral coefficient sheaf, and R_W to the corresponding sheaf on W.left [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. For a rank-one locally free R_X-module sheaf L and an isomorphism from its restriction to the slice at W to the regular coefficient module restricted to that slice, the actual completed derived inverse image [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] along W.hom of L placed in degree zero is isomorphic to R_W placed in degree zero. No noetherian or dimension hypothesis on X is imposed.

proof.text: Apply line_unbounded_derived_tensor to the given locally free line. Its single complex is K-flat and has flat terms, hence is an object of integralOperationsGoodComplex. Evaluate integralDerivedPullbackComparison on it, and use singleFunctorIsoCompQ to identify its localization with the given degree-zero derived object.

The quotient-basis lemma supplies isomorphisms from every actual finite pulled quotient to the corresponding identity-scalar quotient of the regular complex on W.left, and equality of the consecutive transition squares. NatTrans.ofOpSequence and NatIso.ofComponents assemble these into an isomorphism of the full strict towers. Map it through integralOperationsRoosFunctor and DerivedCategory.Q.

Choose an auxiliary coefficient test datum. The existing regular_scalar_strict_unit supplies the normalized regular scalar augmentation for the identity coefficient extension. regular_scalar_unit_quasi_isomorphism supplies its inverse isomorphism after localization. Compose with the representative comparison and the localized Roos tower isomorphism, and finish with the inverse singleFunctorIsoCompQ on the regular module.

theorem integralObjectPullbackLine (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)] (W : X.ProEt)
    (L : integralTowerModules l E X) (hL : L.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank 1)
    (e : L.over W ≅
      (SheafOfModules.unit (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E X)).over W) :
    Nonempty ((integralDerivedPullback l E W.hom).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj L) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E W.left)))
